product_overview: PXX is a sovereign, offline-first B2G SaaS platform for territorial management, analytics, and AI-assisted generation of quizzes and routes. It uses a Next.js frontend/BFF, protected admin workflows, and server-side gamification to support both public user experiences and secure administrative operations.
core_goals: Provide a mobile-first single-page application experience with bottom navigation and splash loading
Protect administrative access with session-based auth and a legacy security gate
Deliver executive-level territorial impact analytics for admins
Enable AI-assisted generation of quizzes and routes from territorial data
Track user passport progress and XP through server-side validated gamification

features.name: App Navigation (SPA)
features.description: Single-page application navigation that lets users move between the main app sections from a bottom navigation bar after an initial splash screen.
user_flows: Open / and wait for SplashScreen to complete (~800ms) -> Tap Inici, Explorar, Mapa, or Perfil in the BottomNavigation -> App updates the visible section without a full page reload
Open / and attempt to interact before SplashScreen completes -> UI remains locked during loading -> After splash finishes, tap a navigation button and receive the corresponding section view
Open / and navigate to Mapa or Perfil -> App renders the target section within the SPA shell -> Attempt a direct deep link to /map or /profile and observe the SPA limitation causing the route to fail

features.name: Admin Dashboard & Security Gate
features.description: Protected administrative area that requires Auth.js session validation and a legacy master-password gate before admin data can be accessed.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/municipality with a valid authenticated admin session -> Receive 200 with municipality data -> Open /admin and unlock the legacy security gate using the correct password -> Click Accedir -> Admin dashboard loads secured content
Open /admin without a valid session -> Security middleware blocks access -> No admin data is displayed
GET /api/admin/municipality without authentication -> Receive 401/403 authorization failure -> Admin municipality data is not returned
Open /admin and submit an incorrect legacy password -> Gate remains locked -> Accedir does not grant entry

features.name: Executive Impact Analytics
features.description: Admin-facing KPI and chart reporting for territorial impact analysis.
user_flows: GET /api/analytics/executive-report with a valid admin session -> Receive 200 with KPI metrics and chart-ready data -> Render the executive report in the admin dashboard
GET /api/analytics/executive-report without authentication -> Receive 401/403 error -> Analytics data is not shown
GET /api/analytics/executive-report with an expired or invalid session token -> Receive authorization failure -> Report loading is blocked

features.name: IA Territorial Processing
features.description: AI-powered generation of quizzes and routes from territorial data, protected by authentication and rate limiting.
user_flows: POST /api/ai/generate-quiz with authenticated request payload -> Receive 200 with generated quiz content -> Present the quiz for use in the app
POST /api/ai/generate-route with authenticated request payload -> Receive 200 with generated route content -> Use the route output in the territorial experience
POST /api/ai/generate-quiz without authentication -> Receive 401/403 error -> Quiz generation is denied
POST /api/ai/generate-route after exceeding the IA rate limit -> Receive 429 rate-limited response -> Route generation is blocked until the limit resets

features.name: User Passport & XP Engine
features.description: Server-side gamification system that validates passport progress and XP updates for the user profile experience.
user_flows: Open /profile from the SPA navigation -> App loads the profile page -> Server-side gamification actions return the current passport state and XP progress
Submit a valid gamification action through the profile flow -> Server validates the action -> XP and passport progress are updated and reflected in the UI
Open /profile and request profile gamification data without a valid session or required state -> Server rejects the request -> No XP update is applied
Attempt an invalid gamification action in the profile flow -> Validation fails on the server -> Passport progress remains unchanged
